title: Nostalgiacore Mall Game, based on childhood mall Brisbane 2000’s
author: mermaidfairybunny
selftext:
Toombul nostalgiacore game husband made, for free! Enjoy

https://youtu.be/hQLc\\\_-w0tzo <— Trailer here! 

\*\*With the destruction and rebuilding of good old Toombul, husband was inspired to make this video game based on his memories of Toombul - hanging there in the 90s-2000’s, and also a mode based upon…. A sneaky not-so-legal exploration of it mid-demolishment in 2024.\*\* \*\*\*Potential asbestos was inhaled but a lot of fun was had.\*\*\* 

He made this to play with his mates for shits and giggles. However given how all of us yearn for the simpler times, I suggested we share it in here for you good people to have a play around. 

It’s FREE. Different ways to play - exploring the shopping centre as it was, exploring it as a wreckage (spooooky), modes like zombies are chasing you, “escape the cops”, parachuting in, play mini-games in the arcade, paintball… Typical gaming fun alongside reliving teen/young adult Toombul.

The website is https://toombulgame.com

Disclosure:    
\*Husband works in IT programming, this is entirely just a passion project he made for fun. He did have some supporting help from AI to work out certain things he struggled with programming himself, he’s self-taught in a lot of his work.\*     
*At the moment it’s only available on PC but if people on Macs are wanting their Toombul fix surely he can make it happen!*
